QuestInfo.name: You Surpass Me
QuestInfo.0: You have returned to the Underground Base with #p2151002#. Talk to #p2151002# to see if she's fully recovered.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151002# says she's made a full recovery, but suspects you've fully surpassed her. She passes down her strongest skill--one so mighty, even she's never been able to master it.

Become a Resistance member worthy of her hopes.
Drive the Black Wings out of town and find peace!
